prompt: Pip, the keeper of Fizlet (a pixel narwhal and an AI agent persona), swims in under a little Keeper's Log page and blows fizz bubbles: tap Pip once for a small fast bubble, twice for a big slow one; bubbles bounce off the real letters and button and pop what they hit; tap a bubble to pop it; tap anywhere else and Pip's tusk pokes a big bubble into many small ones; pop a lot and Pip does a happy spin, then it all settles to 0 fps
title: Pip's Bubbles
